acceptanceCriteria: internal/tasks/cli whole-package wall time is under 600 s at load at or above 20, or a make target runs it in committed slices each under 600 s.
The before and after times are recorded in the build log.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1527 (testprov-1021w). The whole internal/tasks/cli package took 688 s through heavy.sh, so the agent tool moved it to the background against the lane charter. CI already splits it (AFP-V0-164, V1-1752), but local lanes cannot run it whole. Expected: the package finishes under 600 s on a loaded host or ships a documented slice set for local use. Actual: 688 s.
title: internal/tasks/cli package test takes 688 s locally, over the 600 s foreground tool ceiling lanes must stay under
